== Notes ==
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* Rush is commonly used as a [[cancel stance]], especially for canceling [[Frenzy]] or [[Primal Rage]] when the user begins taking heavy [[damage]].
